name: Sun Cleric: Judgement of the Valkyrie already shortens Judgement Day's cooldown (#1558)
contract: 300315 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), MiscValue 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 0x8. Judgement Day (806121, the RecoveryTime-60000 player-cast rank; its own EffectTriggerSpell 570125 is only an internal incap driver with no cooldown of its own) carries that same bit in its own SpellFamilyFlags word 1 (0x8). 300315 is not one of the family-33 named-root cases in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod, so the check falls through to the generic flag96 AND, which matches. BasePoints -15001 resolves to -15000 per SpellEffectInfo::CalcBaseValue (DieSides 1 subtracts one from the stored value), matching 'Reduces the cooldown of Judgement Day by 15 sec' exactly. Native only, no server code needed.
